query: UPDATE ops.jobs SET status=CASE WHEN $2 THEN 'QUEUED'::ops.job_status ELSE 'DEAD_LETTER'::ops.job_status END, run_after=CASE WHEN $2 THEN clock_timestamp()+($3 * INTERVAL '1 second') ELSE run_after END, completed_at=CASE WHEN $2 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL, last_error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED',last_error_detail='worker lease expired before completion', version=version+1 WHERE id=$1 AND status='RUNNING' RETURNING version
